settings.heading: Scent the celebration.
settings.lead: Invite Maison Veil’s luxury perfume bar to your wedding, shower, birthday, or brand gathering. Guests blend their own signature scents—an interactive ritual they will talk about long after the last toast.

settings.title: A love story in sillage
settings.text: Give guests a scent to keep: classic and modern accords, bottles sized for favors, and a bar styled to your palette. Capture the day in something they can wear home.

settings.title: Birthdays, showers, nights in
settings.text: A luxurious, hands-on station for intimate parties and milestone gatherings. We tailor the bar to your theme so every pour feels like the event itself.

settings.title: Activations that linger
settings.text: Conferences, launches, client appreciation, and team nights—custom-branded bottles and scent stations that make your brand memorable on skin.

settings.title: Make it memorable.
settings.description: From the first guest to the last bottle, Maison Veil designs perfume-bar experiences that feel couture, personal, and impossible to forget. Complimentary delivery on fragrance orders over $100 when you shop the house.

settings.title: Curated accords
settings.description: A wide selection of high-quality oils and finished scents—florals, gourmands, woods, and ambers.

settings.title: Styled to you

settings.title: Guest bottles
